row.reason: Both are field-based inspection and service providers to commercial, industrial, data center and public-sector facility owners. APi sells hands-on installation, inspection and maintenance of fire, life safety, HVAC and elevator systems. TIC sells testing, inspection, certification and engineering services, including non-destructive testing and building commissioning, with a heavier energy and industrial asset-integrity focus. Customers overlap, but the core offerings only partly overlap, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
